failure_reason: The persistent warm-volume path completed all six resident Runtime, UTS-to-ACC, signed dehydration and restore, actual replay-denial, and pending-only continuation work. Guardian authenticated to the Runtime internally and published the pre-restart barrier, but the parallel Python HTTPS/WSS probe never acknowledged it, so the six-hour exposure did not start. Code inspection found that this probe used the server certificate-chain file as its CA source instead of the configured trust-roots file used by the successful Rust client; its retry loop then masked earlier error classes with the final connection refusal after Guardian shutdown.
